literal_meaning: বচন (কথা) + বাগীশ (বাকপটু) / সর্বস্ব (সম্পূর্ণ সম্পত্তি বা নির্ভরতা)
figurative_meaning_en: A scholar of words; someone who relies entirely on eloquence or speech
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে একটা বচনবাগীশ/সর্বস্ব, কথায় সবাইকে মুগ্ধ করে কিন্তু কাজে কিছু করে না।
example_sentences_in_english: He is a word-worshipper/all-in-all, charming everyone with his speech but doing nothing in action.
This politician is known as a silver-tongued orator who lives by his words.
note: The idiom emphasizes reliance on verbal skills over practical actions, common in Bengali expressive culture.
